title: Bugun ozeti ve tekil devam CTA
purpose: Today summary card embedded in home.dashboard. Shows active content target, countdown to 23:59, single Devam Et CTA (AC-FR-E2-01-01/02). If no active content, shows Kesfe Cik link (AC-FR-E2-01-03). Offline: last synced summary (AC-FR-E2-01-04).

loading.description: Skeleton card (height 120) with shimmer animation while ContentProgress loads. PActivityIndicator shown.

ready.description: Card shows: content icon, title, 'Modul X/Y', progress bar (%), Live 23:59 countdown timer updated every minute, single Devam Et button. AC-FR-E2-01-01/02 satisfied.

empty.description: No active content: motivational empty card -- 'Bugunku hedefini sec' headline, 'Kesfete Cik' CTA link to Discover. AC-FR-E2-01-03 satisfied.

error.description: Inline card error: 'Bugun ozeti yuklenemedi. Tekrar Dene' button. AC-FR-E2-09-03 satisfied.

offline.description: Last synced summary visible. Countdown timer continues from device clock. Devam Et enabled for cached content. AC-FR-E2-01-04 satisfied.
